summary: FD_TC_030_Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 9+ hrs | AC Wallet (20%)
title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 9+ hrs | AC Wallet (20%)
description:
Validates an end-to-end eligible flight disruption claim scenario for a multi-passenger family/group booking of 6 passengers where the primary claimant is an active Aeroplan member. Flight AC 434 (YUL?YYZ) is delayed 10 hours (APPR Tier 3: 9+ hrs band) due to a controllable reason (Code 15 / Code 42 - Scheduled Maintenance / Technical Delay). The primary claimant selects AC Wallet payout for all 6 passengers. Validates the 20% top-up calculation at the highest compensation band: base $1,000 CAD + 20% = $1,200 CAD per passenger, totaling $7,200 CAD AC Wallet ($6,000 CAD base equivalent). Confirms that DDS returns EL-03, CyberSource passes GREEN, Persona IDV passes, the payment record routes to EIP/iFly rather than Unifier, and Claims Dashboard reflects 6 passengers in read-only resolved state with AC Wallet payout.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC022 � 6 passengers: Nathalie Fortin (Adult - Primary Claimant, Aeroplan Member 1234567890), Marc Fortin (Adult), Eric Fortin (Adult), Julie Fortin (Adult), Lucas Fortin (Child), Emma Fortin (Child). Journey: 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ (Flight AC 434). Scheduled arrival: 08:00. Actual arrival: 18:00 (10hr delay � Delay band: 9+ hours). Arrival delay code: 15 / 42 (Scheduled Maintenance / Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+38). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. Aeroplan: Linked (1234567890), account active and in good standing (NOT frozen). CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN. Persona: Configured to return IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD). Payment: AC Wallet selected for all 6 passengers.
